data.title: S4L7 — Harf-e-Jarr ba-Zameer: بَيْتُكَ ← فِي بَيْتِكَ: Buniyadi Misaalein
data.caption: S4L7 — Harf-e-Jarr ba-Zameer: بَيْتُكَ ← فِي بَيْتِكَ: Buniyadi Misaalein
rows: فِي بَيْتِكَ / مِنْ رَبِّكَ / إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ
Tere ghar mein / Aapke Rabb ki taraf se / Aapke Rabb ki taraf
Beshak aapka Rabb / Beshak aapki namaz
رَحْمَةُ رَبِّكَ / صِرَاطُ رَبِّكَ / عَذَابُ رَبِّكَ
Aapke Rabb ki rahmat / raasta / azaab

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 17–19):** Jab `ـكَ` wale ism se pehle Harf-e-Jarr (`فِي`، `مِنْ`، `إِلَىٰ`، `بِـ`، `عَلَىٰ`، `عَنْ`) ya Mudaaf aata hai toh `ـكَ` se pehle wale harf ke neeche Zair (`ـِ`) aa jati hai (`فِي بَيْتِكَ`، `مِنْ رَبِّكَ`، `رَحْمَةُ رَبِّكَ`), aur `إِنَّ` aane par Zabar aata hai (`إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ`). Isi sabaq mein Harf-e-Jarr `عَنْ` ('se / ke baare mein') ki exercise bhi shamil hai.

translations.ur: آپ کے رب کی طرف سے
آپ کے رب کے بارے میں
آپ کا ہاتھ / آپ کے گریبان میں

items.hinglish: Madad aapke Rabb ki taraf se
items.hinglish_meaning: Madad aapke Rabb ki taraf se

translations.hinglish: Madad aapke Rabb ki taraf se
translations.ur: مدد / آپ کے رب کی طرف سے
translations.hi: मदद / आपके रब की तरफ़ से

items.hinglish: Karam aapke Rabb ki taraf se
items.hinglish_meaning: Karam aapke Rabb ki taraf se

translations.hinglish: Karam aapke Rabb ki taraf se
translations.ur: فضل (کرم) / آپ کے رب کی طرف سے
translations.hi: फ़ज़्ल (करम) / आपके रब की तरफ़ से

items.hinglish: Tere khane ki taraf aur tere peene ki cheez ki taraf
items.hinglish_meaning: Tere khane ki taraf aur tere peene ki cheez ki taraf

translations.hinglish: Tere khane ki taraf aur tere peene ki cheez ki taraf
translations.en: At your food / and your drink
translations.ur: تیرے کھانے کی طرف / اور تیرے پینے کی چیز کی طرف
translations.hi: तेरे खाने की तरफ़ / और तेरे पीने की चीज़ की तरफ़

items.hinglish: Aapke Rabb ki taraf se sarkashi aur kufr mein
items.hinglish_meaning: Aapke Rabb ki taraf se sarkashi aur kufr mein

translations.hinglish: Aapke Rabb ki taraf se sarkashi aur kufr mein
translations.en: From your Lord / in transgression and disbelief
translations.ur: آپ کے رب کی طرف سے / سرکشی اور کفر میں
translations.hi: आपके रब की तरफ़ से / सरकशी और कुफ़्र में

items.hinglish: Rahmat aapke Rabb ki taraf se
items.hinglish_meaning: Rahmat aapke Rabb ki taraf se

translations.hinglish: Rahmat aapke Rabb ki taraf se
translations.ur: رحمت / آپ کے رب کی طرف سے
translations.hi: रहमत / आपके रब की तरफ़ से

items.hinglish: Chakkar lagane wala aapke Rabb ki taraf se
items.hinglish_meaning: Chakkar lagane wala aapke Rabb ki taraf se

translations.hinglish: Chakkar lagane wala aapke Rabb ki taraf se
translations.ur: ایک چکر لگانے والا (عذاب) / آپ کے رب کی طرف سے
translations.hi: चक्कर लगाने वाला / आपके रब की तरफ़ से

items.hinglish: Aapke Rabb ki taraf se Fir'awn ki taraf
items.hinglish_meaning: Aapke Rabb ki taraf se Fir'awn ki taraf

translations.hinglish: Aapke Rabb ki taraf se Fir'awn ki taraf
translations.ur: آپ کے رب کی طرف سے / فرعون کی طرف
translations.hi: आपके रब की तरफ़ से / फ़िरऔन की तरफ़

items.hinglish: Haq aapke Rabb ki taraf se hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Haq aapke Rabb ki taraf se hai

translations.hinglish: Haq aapke Rabb ki taraf se hai
translations.en: The truth is from your Lord
translations.ur: حق آپ کے رب کی طرف سے ہے
translations.hi: हक़ आपके रब की तरफ़ से है

items.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb kushada bakhshish wala hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapka Rabb kushada bakhshish wala hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb kushada bakhshish wala hai
translations.en: Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کا رب کشادہ بخشش والا ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपका रब कुशादा बख़्शिश वाला है

items.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb wohi sab se zyada jaanne wala hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapka Rabb wohi sab se zyada jaanne wala hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb wohi sab se zyada jaanne wala hai
translations.en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کا رب وہی سب سے زیادہ جاننے والا ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपका रब वही सबसे ज़्यादा जानने वाला है

items.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan bakhshish wala hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan bakhshish wala hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan bakhshish wala hai
translations.en: Indeed, your Lord is surely possessor of forgiveness
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کا رب یقیناً بخشش والا ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपका रब यक़ीनन बख़्शिश वाला है

items.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan jald azab dene wala hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan jald azab dene wala hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan jald azab dene wala hai
translations.en: Indeed, your Lord is surely swift in retribution
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کا رب یقیناً جلد عذاب دینے والا ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपका रब यक़ीनन जल्द अज़ाब देने वाला है

translations.en: In Your hand is all good
translations.ur: آپ ہی کے ہاتھ میں بھلائی ہے

items.hinglish: Beshak aapke Rabb ki taraf lotna hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapke Rabb ki taraf lotna hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapke Rabb ki taraf lotna hai
translations.en: Indeed, to your Lord is the return
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کے رب کی طرف لوٹنا ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपके रब की तरफ़ लौटना है

items.hinglish: Aur ke aapke Rabb ki taraf aakhri thikana hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Aur ke aapke Rabb ki taraf aakhri thikana hai

translations.hinglish: Aur ke aapke Rabb ki taraf aakhri thikana hai
translations.en: And that to your Lord is the final destination
translations.ur: اور یہ کہ آپ کے رب کی طرف ہی آخری ٹھکانا ہے
translations.hi: और यह कि आपके रब की तरफ़ ही आख़िरी ठिकाना है

items.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan ghat mein hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan ghat mein hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan ghat mein hai
translations.en: Indeed, your Lord is surely in observation
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کا رب یقیناً گھات میں ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपका रब यक़ीनन घात में है

translations.ur: بیشک آپ کی نماز تسکین (سکون) ہے

items.hinglish: Aur beshak tera wada haq hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Aur beshak tera wada haq hai

translations.hinglish: Aur beshak tera wada haq hai
translations.en: And indeed, Your promise is the truth
translations.ur: اور بیشک آپ کا وعدہ سچا (حق) ہے
translations.hi: और बेशक आपका वादा सच्चा (हक़) है

items.hinglish: Aur beshak woh yaqeenan haq hai aapke Rabb ki taraf se
items.hinglish_meaning: Aur beshak woh yaqeenan haq hai aapke Rabb ki taraf se

translations.hinglish: Aur beshak woh yaqeenan haq hai aapke Rabb ki taraf se
translations.en: And indeed, it is the truth from your Lord
translations.ur: اور بیشک وہ یقیناً حق ہے آپ کے رب کی طرف سے
translations.hi: और बेशक वह यक़ीनन हक़ है आपके रब की तरफ़ से

items.hinglish: Aapke Rabb ki taraf uska khatma hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Aapke Rabb ki taraf uska khatma hai

translations.hinglish: Aapke Rabb ki taraf uska khatma hai
translations.en: To your Lord is its finality
translations.ur: آپ کے رب ہی کی طرف اس کا خاتمہ ہے
translations.hi: आपके रब ही की तरफ़ उसका ख़ात्मा है

items.hinglish: Beshak aapka dushman wohi be-nasl hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapka dushman wohi be-nasl hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapka dushman wohi be-nasl hai
translations.en: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کا دشمن ہی بے نسل ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपका दुश्मन ही बे-नस्ल है

items.arabic_markup: هَذَا هُوَ الْحَقُّ / مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
items.hinglish: Yeh hi haq hai teri taraf se
items.hinglish_meaning: Yeh hi haq hai teri taraf se

translations.hinglish: Yeh hi haq hai teri taraf se
translations.en: This is the truth from You
translations.ur: یہی حق ہے آپ کی طرف سے
translations.hi: यही हक़ है आपकी तरफ़ से

translations.ur: یہ آپ کی طرف سے ہے

items.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ / لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ / وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
items.arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ / لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ / وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
items.arabic_markup: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ / لَذُو مَغْفِرَةٍ / وَذُو عِقَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
items.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan bakhshish wala hai aur dardnaak azab wala hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan bakhshish wala hai aur dardnaak azab wala hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan bakhshish wala hai aur dardnaak azab wala hai
translations.en: Indeed, your Lord is possessor of forgiveness and possessor of painful retribution
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کا رب یقیناً بخشش والا ہے اور دردناک عذاب والا ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपका रब यक़ीनन बख़्शिश वाला है और दर्दनाक अज़ाब वाला है

items.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ الْعِقَابِ / وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
items.arabic_text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ الْعِقَابِ / وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
items.arabic_markup: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَسَرِيعُ الْعِقَابِ / وَإِنَّهُ لَغَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ
items.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan jald azab dene wala hai aur beshak woh yaqeenan bakhshne wala meharban hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan jald azab dene wala hai aur beshak woh yaqeenan bakhshne wala meharban hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapka Rabb yakinan jald azab dene wala hai aur beshak woh yaqeenan bakhshne wala meharban hai
translations.en: Indeed, your Lord is swift in retribution, and indeed, He is Forgiving and Merciful
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کا رب یقیناً جلد عذاب دینے والا ہے اور بیشک وہ یقیناً بخشنے والا مہربان ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपका रब यक़ीनन जल्द अज़ाब देने वाला है और बेशक वह यक़ीनन बख़्शने वाला मेहरबान है

items.arabic: يَا نُوحُ / إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ / إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ
items.arabic_text: يَا نُوحُ / إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ / إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ
items.arabic_markup: يَا نُوحُ / إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ / إِنَّهُ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَالِحٍ
items.hinglish: Aye Nuh! beshak woh tere ghar-walon mein se nahin hai beshak woh bura amal hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Aye Nuh! beshak woh tere ghar-walon mein se nahin hai beshak woh bura amal hai

translations.hinglish: Aye Nuh! beshak woh tere ghar-walon mein se nahin hai beshak woh bura amal hai
translations.en: O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [an embodiment of] unrighteous work
translations.ur: اے نوح! بیشک وہ تیرے گھر والوں میں سے نہیں ہے، بیشک وہ برا عمل ہے
translations.hi: ऐ नूह! बेशक वह तेरे घर वालों में से नहीं है, बेशक वह बुरा अमल है

items.arabic_markup: وَالْبَاقِيَاتُ الصَّالِحَاتُ خَيْرٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ
items.hinglish: Aur baqi rehne wali nek nekiyan aapke Rabb ke paas behtar hain
items.hinglish_meaning: Aur baqi rehne wali nek nekiyan aapke Rabb ke paas behtar hain

translations.hinglish: Aur baqi rehne wali nek nekiyan aapke Rabb ke paas behtar hain
translations.en: And the enduring good deeds are better with your Lord
translations.ur: اور باقی رہنے والی نیکیاں آپ کے رب کے پاس بہتر ہیں
translations.hi: और बाक़ी रहने वाली नेकियाँ आपके रब के पास बेहतर हैं

items.arabic: وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا / عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ / كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ
items.arabic_text: وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا / عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ / كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ
items.arabic_markup: وَإِنَّ يَوْمًا / عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ / كَأَلْفِ سَنَةٍ
items.hinglish: Aur beshak ek din aapke Rabb ke paas hazar saal ki tarah hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Aur beshak ek din aapke Rabb ke paas hazar saal ki tarah hai

translations.hinglish: Aur beshak ek din aapke Rabb ke paas hazar saal ki tarah hai
translations.en: And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years
translations.ur: اور بیشک ایک دن آپ کے رب کے نزدیک ہزار سال کی مانند ہے
translations.hi: और बेशक एक दिन आपके रब के पास हज़ार साल की तरह है

items.hinglish: Aur yeh aapke Rabb ka rasta hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Aur yeh aapke Rabb ka rasta hai

translations.hinglish: Aur yeh aapke Rabb ka rasta hai
translations.en: And this is the path of your Lord
translations.ur: اور یہ آپ کے رب کا راستہ ہے
translations.hi: और यह आपके रब का रास्ता है

items.hinglish: Aur aapke Rabb ki rahmat behtar hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Aur aapke Rabb ki rahmat behtar hai

translations.hinglish: Aur aapke Rabb ki rahmat behtar hai
translations.en: And the mercy of your Lord is better
translations.ur: اور آپ کے رب کی رحمت بہتر ہے
translations.hi: और आपके रब की रहमत बेहतर है

items.hinglish: Toh aapke Rabb ka maal behtar hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Toh aapke Rabb ka maal behtar hai

translations.hinglish: Toh aapke Rabb ka maal behtar hai
translations.en: Then the reward of your Lord is better
translations.ur: تو آپ کے رب کا صلہ (مال) بہتر ہے
translations.hi: तो आपके रब का माल बेहतर है

items.hinglish: Aur aapke Rabb ka rizq behtar aur baqi rehne wala hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Aur aapke Rabb ka rizq behtar aur baqi rehne wala hai

translations.hinglish: Aur aapke Rabb ka rizq behtar aur baqi rehne wala hai
translations.en: And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring
translations.ur: اور آپ کے رب کا رزق بہتر اور باقی رہنے والا ہے
translations.hi: और आपके रब का रिज़्क़ बेहतर और बाक़ी रहने वाला है

items.hinglish: Beshak aapke Rabb ki pakad yakinan sakht hai
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapke Rabb ki pakad yakinan sakht hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapke Rabb ki pakad yakinan sakht hai
translations.en: Indeed, the grip of your Lord is surely severe
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کے رب کی پکڑ یقیناً سخت ہے
translations.hi: बेशक आपके रब की पकड़ यक़ीनन सख़्त है

items.hinglish: Beshak aapke Rabb ka azab darne ke qabil tha
items.hinglish_meaning: Beshak aapke Rabb ka azab darne ke qabil tha

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapke Rabb ka azab darne ke qabil tha
translations.en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord was ever feared
translations.ur: بیشک آپ کے رب کا عذاب ڈرنے کے قابل تھا
translations.hi: बेशक आपके रब का अज़ाब डरने के क़ाबिल था

items.hinglish: Beshak aapke Rabb ka azab yakinan hone wala hai

translations.hinglish: Beshak aapke Rabb ka azab yakinan hone wala hai

items.hinglish: Aur nahin tha aapke Rabb ka ataa rok diya gaya

translations.hinglish: Aur nahin tha aapke Rabb ka ataa rok diya gaya

translations.hi: और नहीं था आपके रब का अता रोक दिया गया
